questions.question:
From the given alternatives, select the word which CANNOT be formed using the letters of the given word.

Endeavors
questions.solution:
Let’s check each option,

1) VOTE → cannot be formed because there is no ‘T’ in ENDEAVORS.

2) ROSE → can be formed as END**E**AV**ORS**.

3) END → can be formed as **END**EAVORS**.**

4) DONE → can be formed as **END**EAV**O**RS.

So, VOTE can’t be formed from word ENDEAVORS.

Hence, the correct answer is **"VOTE".**

questions.question:

Similarly,

Teacher : ? → A teacher works in a School.

Hence, ‘School’ is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Select the option that is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

11 : 143 : : 15 : ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed is,

11 : 143

11 : 112 + (11 × 2)

Similarly,

15 : ?

15 : 152 + (15 × 2)

15 : 225 + 30

15 : 255

‘255’ is related to the third number in the same way as the second number is related to the first number.

Hence, “255” is the correct answer.

questions.question:
A & B means ‘A is the wife of B’

A # B means ‘A is the father of B’

A @ B means ‘A is the son B’

A % B means ‘A is the husband of B’

A + B means ‘A is the mother of B’

If A & B # C & D @ E % F + G, then how is A related to D?
questions.solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85d5a935d623a41a2055d7118a30cb95a4dc5b577d68921c46f443937a8a4ad0.png] 

Given:

 
 

 A & B
 A is the wife of B
 
 

 A # B
 A is the father of B
 
 

 A @ B
 A is the son B
 
 

 A % B
 A is the husband of B
 
 

 A + B
 A is the mother of B
 
 

Now we substitute the values in the given equation:

A & B # C & D @ E % F + G becomes A is the wife of B, B is the father of C, C is the wife of D, D is the son E, E is the husband of F, F is the mother of G. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7c4a24475ca12a8c7f58bd821e43410255eaeb86b52ae06bde1fc888f09a310c.png] 

From the chart we can see that,** A is mother-in-law of D.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**

questions.question: The second number in the given number pairs is obtained by performing certain mathematical operation(s) on the first number. The same operation(s) are followed in all the number pairs, EXCEPT one. Find that odd number pair.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Second number is six times of the first number.**

1) 40 : 240 → 40 × 6 = 240

2) 25 : 150 → 25 × 6 = 150

3) **35 : 280 **→ 35 × 6 = **210 ≠ 280**

4) 30 : 180 → 30 × 6 = 180

Hence, **option** **3** is the odd one.

Pen is called colour.

questions.question:
If ‘+’ means ‘-’, ‘-’ means ‘÷’, ‘÷’ means ‘×’, and ‘×‘ means ‘+’. Which of the following will be the value of the expression?

117 - 13 ÷ 6 + 24 × 26
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ebbe3d2027f356bcb7877bb116ec4e0e9f132ef1b027d38df9bd08205965f30f.png] 

 
 

 **Signs**
 +
 -
 ÷
 ×
 
 

 **Means**
 -
 ÷
 ×
 +
 
 

After replacing the signs, the equation we get:

→ **117 ÷ 13** × 6 - 24 + 26 

= **9 ×**** 6** - 24 + 26

= **54** - 24 **+**** 26**

= 80 - 24

= 56

Hence, the correct answer is **"56"**.

questions.question:
Select the option that represents the letters which, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will complete the letter series.

A _ _ D F _ K _ _ F A _ L _ _

options.text: D L K L F A L D
L A L K D F D K
K L A L D K D F
F D L A K F D L

questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Given Sequence: A _ _ D F _ K _ _ F A _ L _ _

Now, putting the letters in the blank spaces given in the option one by one:

Option 1) D L K L F A L D → A **__D__** __L__ D F / **__K__** K __L__ **__F__** F / A **__A__** L **__L__** **__D__**

Option 2) L A L K D F D K → A **__L__** **__A__** D F / **__L__** K **__K__** __D__ F / A **__F__** L __D__ **__K__**

Option 3) **K L A L D K D F** → A __**K**__ **__L__** D F / **__A__** K **__L__** **__D__** F / A __K__ L **__D__** **__F__**

Here, 'Option 3' followed a pattern.

Option 4) F D L A K F D L → A **__F__** **__D__** D F / **__L__** K **__A__** **__K__** F / A **__F__** L __D__ **__L__**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
In the question two statements are given, followed by two conclusions, I and II. You have to consider the statements to be true even if it seems to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which of the given conclusions, if any, follows from the given statements.

**Statement I:** No shoes are boots.

**Statement II:** No sneakers are shoes.

**Conclusion I:** Some boots are sneakers.

**Conclusion II:** All sneakers are boots.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor conclusion II follows

questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1fd57c75de09adf26d4b4d6ef4779b5d5f131c9c0fc548e0406b260a9552470a.png] 

Conclusion I: Some boots are sneakers → False.

Conclusion II: All sneakers are boots → False.

Hence, Neither Conclusion I nor II follows.
